q: How do we answer the BRSR question on compliance with environmental laws?
title: BRSR environmental compliance question
short: Principle 6 essential indicator 12 asks whether the company complies with environmental laws such as the Water Act, the Air Act and the Environment Protection Act and rules. If not, list each non-compliance: the law, the details, any fines or penalties from pollution control boards or courts, and corrective action.

ul: If No, for each case: the law, regulation or guideline not complied with.
Fines, penalties or action by regulators such as pollution control boards, or by courts.

sections.h: Build it from records you already keep
ul: Consent to establish and consent to operate for each plant, with expiry dates.
Show cause notices and closure directions received in the year.
Stack and effluent monitoring reports against consent limits.

p: A notice that was resolved still belongs in the table with its outcome. An honest list with corrective action reads better to investors than a bare Yes that a news story later contradicts.

senseible: Senseible reads kWh, litres and kg from electricity bills and fuel invoices into a dated record per site, with the factor and source on every line, and prepares BRSR drafts from that data. Reports are self-declared drafts.

sources.label: SEBI LODR Master Circular, 11 July 2023, Annexure 16 (BRSR format)
